notes.title: 「Isha Magic Book Decoding」Released！
notes.notes:
The sequel to "Isha Magical Library," titled "Isha Magic Book Decoding" has been released! 

This new installment features significantly more content, including new elements for in-depth gameplay, such as item customization for dungeon exploration and a magic book editing function! Additionally, besides Isha, two more playable characters join the fray in this installment!

As a launch discount, you can get it for 30% off for the first two weeks after release! Be sure to check it out!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3523760/_/

Release Date: March 7, 2025

notes.title: 特殊ダンジョン：裏チェムチェミ湖 追加
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43978836/62334b99630e79f96cc106421a559074166edccb.png[/img]

・Added a special dungeon "Hidden Chemchemi Lake"
A special dungeon where you start with powerful ancient magic and knowledge starts at 8.
Boss is the best ever. Let's master the ancient magic and win.
Several new items are available exclusively in the dungeon.

notes.title: Special Dungeon: Another Kuanjia Forest added
notes.notes:
・Added special dungeon "Another Kuanjia Forest"
A dungeon where MP is automatically restored every turn and only spellbooks can be used. How to use MP is the key.
In addition, 10 new spellbooks are available exclusively for dungeons.
·Functional improvement
Added a game end button, and made it possible to attach and detach items by right-clicking.
·Bug fixes
Fixed some bugs

For details, please refer to the HoukagoSeitokai official website.
https://www.houkagoseitokai.com/ishamagiclibrary/update/ver1_1_0

notes.title: "Isha's Magic Library" Steam Release Campaign
notes.notes:
Let's post a screenshot of the score screen when clearing the final dungeon "Vurumai" on Twitter

Please post a screenshot of the item organization and result screen when clearing with the hashtag "#イシャ図書".
